Is the BJP preparing to convene a special session of Parliament in November, ahead of the regular Winter Session scheduled for December? The Indian Express has learnt that the government is weighing the possibility of a special session, with the Delimitation Bill potentially back on the agenda.
Neeta Sharma explains the BJP's claimed 15–18 vote margin, the questions surrounding its parliamentary arithmetic, the impact of the TMC split, the DMK's resistance over Tamil Nadu's share of seats and the Opposition's unity challenge. What could determine the fate of the Delimitation Bill this time?
